propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table contains only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but is missing the DEFAULT_MODEL us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 and global.* prefix variants, leaving them unguarded against temperature parameter rejection.

Temperature and top_p parameters are deprecated (rejected with 400 ValidationException) on claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7 but not on claude-sonnet-4-6; the rejection is of parameter tunability (temp=1.0 succeeds, temp=0.0 and temp=0.5 fail), not support.

The Anthropic direct adapter (pydantic-ai models/anthropic.py:641) silently drops temperature and warns; the Bedrock adapter has no such drop and returns 400, causing the same defect to manifest as two symptoms on two code paths.

Pass-2 code-review workflow pins temperature=0 for determinism but runs on claude-opus-4-8 which rejects it; the parameter is silently dropped in production on the Anthropic path, causing nondeterministic resampling when determinism is required.
The override table must cover both provider-prefixed forms (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8, bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8) and bare ids, with both us.* and global.* Bedrock profile prefixes.
